note: SCB documents WEIGHT (variable 5, edition 99 = 2009) with the generic Mattenhet placeholder 'värde, antal eller %', which names no unit (#1881). A unit correction with `clear = true` drops it, so neither the state nor the variable states a unit.
fails_if: a cleared `[[errata.field]]` unit correction emits no effect or a value effect instead of an absent replacement, so WEIGHT keeps the placeholder as its unit

sources.description: Variable 5 delivers WEIGHT in edition 99 (2009, CVID 20) with the placeholder unit.
